adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms swing naturally; hands hold instruments or drumsticks (yeolchae/gungchae).
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso remains stable while hips and knees drive the rhythmic pulse.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Acrobatic elements are common in sogo dance.
movement_profile.posture: Upright but flexible, with knees slightly bent to facilitate rhythmic movement.

signature_moves.description: Twirling a long ribbon attached to a hat using head and knee movements.
signature_moves.name: Sangmonori

signature_moves.description: Complex group formations presented during the performance.
signature_moves.name: Jinpuri

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Constant motion, varying from graceful (udo) to rapid (jwado).

music_profile.sound_description: A dense, polyrhythmic texture dominated by metallic gong strikes and deep drum thuds, punctuated by the high-pitched, piercing melody of the taepyeongso.

basic_steps: Basic walking step (bal-noleum) synchronized with the drum beat.
Knee-bend (deul-sawi) to power the sangmo ribbon rotation.
Formation shifting (jinpuri) in a group circle.
teaching.formation: Outdoor procession or circular group formation.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic rhythmic walking; advanced students focus on sangmo ribbon control and acrobatic sogo techniques.
